seo.description: Friendly shadow who sells rare goods in the sewers. Void eggs and diamonds feel like home.

stardew.intro: A shadow who prefers peace with humans. Lives in the sewers, sells unique items, and can become a roommate.

relationships.name: Wizard
relationships.note: The Wizard vouches that Krobus means no harm.

trivia: Friendship caps at 10 hearts — he cannot receive a bouquet but can move in as a roommate.
